html:
SMTO-CAP-0013 — SMTO couldn't load the full set of tools it asked for

GUID: ca2a9126-344c-551b-adbe-20a5da0aaadc
Slug: tool-discovery-selection-invalid
Domain: CAP · Subsystem: tool

What happened

  • SMTO's Agent asked to load a group of tools, but at least one isn't available in this Task. SMTO rejected the whole request instead of quietly loading only part of it. Nothing was run.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Watch the Task. If it carries on with a smaller set of tools, you don't need to do anything. SMTO tells the Agent which Skill to look up again, so it can choose only tools that are allowed.
  2. If the Task stops, open Capabilities by the message box and check the tools you need aren't set to Never or − Exclude and aren't marked Unavailable. Blocked or unavailable tools can't be loaded in this Task.
  3. Check the Agent mode menu by the message box. If it says Ask, switch it to Agent for work that needs tools. Ask mode only gives advice, so tools that change things aren't loaded there.
  4. Check which steps the stopped Task already finished, then send a new request for the rest. Capability changes apply to the next request, and checking first avoids repeating finished work.

What success looks like

  • The next Task loads the tools it needs and keeps working without this message.

If it still fails

  • Send Copy error details to the person who manages SMTO; they list the tools that were asked for. Don't resend a request whose earlier steps you haven't checked, so work that already happened isn't done twice.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • ToolCatalog._discover raised DiscoverySelectionError because at least one requested capability, Skill entry tool or section tool has no concrete adapter in this run's scope (excluded, unavailable or out of scope); the whole selection was rejected atomically and nothing executed.

What this means

  • Exact discovery selection contains an item without a concrete scoped adapter; the selection is rejected atomically rather than silently dropping entries. Capability discovery and registration describe what this run may request. They do not grant operating-system permission, override exclusions or authorize execution by themselves.

Why this can happen

  • Exact discovery selection contains an item without a concrete scoped adapter; the selection is rejected atomically rather than silently dropping entries.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare every requested selection entry with the current scoped inventory and identify missing or excluded adapters.

How to fix it

  • Compare every requested ID with ToolCatalog.capabilities for the run (_discover in src/agent_runtime/native/catalog.py) and with the run's capability policy and agent mode. Drop excluded or out-of-scope items, or change the capability policy for a new run; the error's retry hint lists the related Skill IDs to rediscover.
  • Refresh the available skill and tool inventory, then select only supported tools for the current capability policy.

Retry and execution caution

  • Confirm current state and correct the reported condition before requesting another attempt. Do not replay work with an unknown outcome.

How to verify the fix

  • The complete intended selection resolves to available scoped adapters without silent substitutions.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained evidence or retry an operation whose effect is unknown.

Technical notes

  • Capability discovery and registration describe what this run may request. They do not grant operating-system permission, override exclusions or authorize execution by themselves.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
